references.text: John 12:48 refers to the 'word' that will judge, which directly echoes the prophecy in Deuteronomy 18:18-19 about a prophet who will speak God's word, and where anyone who does not listen to this word will be judged.
Both texts emphasize the inevitable power of God's word: In Isaiah 55:11 the word goes out and fulfills its purpose, just as the 'word' in John 12:48 is the active judge on the last day.
The judgment in John 12:48 takes place on 'the last day', a theme central to Matthew 25, where Jesus describes the final judgment of the nations based on their actions and response to His message.

In 1 John 5:12-13 eternal life is directly linked to having the 'Son' and listening to His word, while rejection leads to death, reflecting the contrast in John 12:48 between receiving the word and being judged by it.
